messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: It is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI).
Omeprazole reduces how much acid your stomach makes.
Omeprazole does not neutralize acid that is already there.
Triplet: ["Omeprazole", "has drug class", "proton pump inhibitor"]

The relation 'has drug class' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
B. 'includes': The subject drug class or category includes the specific drug or entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
D. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
